description: Audits a public agent or API URL for verifiability: discovery files (llms.txt, MCP card, robots, sitemap), handshake endpoints, and whether presented signed proofs validate. Returns a 0-100 score, a grade, ranked fixes, and a signed proof of the audit. Every result re-derives from a public fetch. Docs: https://api.babyblueviper.com/docs

url.description: The agent endpoint/site URL to audit (public http(s) only)

name: audit_agent_readiness
scope_note: Audits agent/verifiability READINESS (discoverable + presents a verifiable handshake/proof), not output correctness.
